_comment: Known ENVIRONMENT failures only (load sensitivity or harness image gaps), each with evidence. A suite is KNOWN only when every failing test matches a listed phrase. Mirrors the explained items in PR #266 expected-results.json; add nothing here without a reproduction. Chain coverage: the runner derives the chain from every migration above the image cutoff at --base, so it handles 20261206..20261227 (21 files, all with rollbacks, no CRLF, verified statically on origin/main 84f52048). r2b refuses the merged chain by design and must not be run on it.

failing: the entity row is locked before the account row
known.reason: wall-clock assertion (expected N > 900 ms) fails when the host CPU is saturated; passes 20/20 on an idle host (PR #266 notes). Observed 180 ms here under 100% CPU.
property test pinned at 90 s times out under CPU saturation; passes on an idle host (PR #266 notes). Cascades to later assertions in the file; the match requires every failing test to be listed.
pins that no pre-existing '%sms%' function references studio_sms_onboarding; a later TW-4F function legitimately does (PR #266).

failing: the status shows only the current attempt's evaluation events
known.reason: pins exactly 14 tw4_runner_* functions; main has 16 (PR #266).

failing: rollback parses and completes where there is no evidence
known.reason: R2b objects depend on the R2a ledger (2BP01): R2a's rollback cannot run until R2b is rolled back first (PR #266).

failing: the real outbox's own runner can claim and finish what P2 raised
known.reason: KI-3: run 2 (main 78bc699c) failed twice on an idle host with 'expected +0 to be 2'; probable cause (unconfirmed): tw4_rfl_alerts_claim returns nothing while the delivery kill switch is off (fail closed since migration 20261211) and the test does not turn delivery on. Reported as a known item, not a pass.
